logicalBugs.description: Admin > People manages user accounts and their membership in permission groups; its search and paginated list help administrators find those accounts. Searching People for a user’s complete name, exactly as it is displayed in the list, returns no matches even though the user was present before searching. This analysis uses approximate public source because the fixture’s exact runtime source revision was unavailable.
reproductionPaths: Admin > People manages user accounts and their membership in permission groups; its search and paginated list help administrators find those accounts.
